_note: IMAGE -> IMAGE LIKENESS ('make this image look like me / them' — handoff §4.1 'Image -> variation of me' = MAIN ROUTE). Upload any image: its composition, pose and scene survive at the chosen denoise while the face is re-imagined as the SUBJECT — FaceID on a real ground-truth photo plus the profile's SDXL identity pack when installed. Denoise is the identity/fidelity dial: 0.3 stays close to the source, 0.5 balanced, 0.7+ re-imagines freely (more identity, less source). Unlike image.refine (no identity) and unlike the face-zone lane (target geometry pinned), the whole image is re-diffused so the subject's geometry can actually appear.

reference_policy._rule: Real camera photos only (profile references.ground_truth). The job REFUSES if the subject has none.

negative: text, letters, watermark, blurry, low quality, deformed face, distorted features, different person, plastic skin

prompt.label: Describe the result (blank = keep the source's own description)

rubric.identity: 1-5 — does the person now read as the SUBJECT at normal viewing size?
rubric.source_fidelity: 1-5 — did composition, pose and scene survive the redraw?
